newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines asks China to spare Filipina's life.
newsitem.headline: Philippines asks China to spare Filipina's life.

text.p: President Fidel Ramos said on Wednesday he had appealed to Chinese President Jiang Zemin to spare the life of a Filipina condemned to death by a court in Guangzhou for smuggling narcotics.

Joana Francisco was convicted by the Guangzhou Municipal Intermediate People's Court on June 25. The death sentence it imposed on her was affirmed by the Guangdong Provincial Higher Court on August 2, a Presidential Palace statement said.
Ramos, in a letter to Jiang, asked for a commutation of the sentence, the statement said.

"The government of the Republic of the Philippines, the Filipino people and I, personally, would deeply appreciate Your Excellency's favourable consideration of this request in behalf of Ms Joana A. Francisco," Ramos said, according to the statement.
Ramos's appeal to the United Arab Emirates last year in behalf of Filipina maid Sarah Balabagan, who also was facing a death sentence, led to the maid being released after about a year in jail.

Balabagan, convicted by a UAE court of killing her Arab employer, whom she had accused of raping her, recently returned to the Philippines. A local movie company has bought the rights to turn her life story into a film.
